regulation_b.name: GDPR
regulation_b.title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority

validation.reasoning: Both articles address the need for timely reporting and management of incidents that could impact personal data and operational resilience.
validation.suggested_scenario_seed: A financial entity experiences a cyber-attack that compromises customer data and disrupts digital services.

validation.reasoning: The articles impose distinct yet complementary obligations on financial entities to manage cybersecurity risks and third-party ICT risks.
validation.suggested_scenario_seed: A financial entity using third-party ICT services must ensure compliance with both DORA Article 28 and NIS2 Article 21 to manage cybersecurity risks effectively.
